definitions.explanation: The time period shortly after midday, roughly from 12:00 to 2:00 PM. Indicates the time has just passed noon.

examples.japanese: {昼過|ひるす}ぎに{届|とど}きます。
examples.english: It will arrive in the early afternoon.

examples.japanese: {昼過|ひるす}ぎから{雨|あめ}が{降|ふ}り{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: It started raining in the early afternoon.

examples.japanese: {昼過|ひるす}ぎまで{寝|ね}てしまって、{午後|ごご}の{予定|よてい}に{遅|おく}れそうになった。
examples.english: I slept until early afternoon and nearly missed my afternoon plans.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {昼|ひる} (noon, midday) + {過|す}ぎ (past, after). Refers specifically to the time just after noon, roughly 12:00-2:00 PM. Part of a common pattern for expressing approximate times: {朝|あさ} (morning), {昼|ひる} (noon), {昼過|ひるす}ぎ (early afternoon), {夕方|ゆうがた} (evening), {夜|よる} (night).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {昼過|ひるす}ぎに: in the early afternoon
- {昼過|ひるす}ぎから: from early afternoon
- {昼過|ひるす}ぎまで: until early afternoon

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {午後|ごご}: afternoon (formal, precise)
- {昼|ひる}: noon, midday
- {夕方|ゆうがた}: evening, late afternoon
